svg.text: GE2340 — measured stops and movement recordings (17 Nov 2026)
Hong Kong time. Stop labels are provisional (route-inferred); device clocks were not independently synchronized.
Pressure median per stop (hPa); separate dots, no invented readings between stops
Magnetic field magnitude median per stop (µT)
Recorded intervals: teal = stationary barometer/magnetometer stop; orange = accelerometer movement
The walk revisits Y5, the toilet, the exit, the canteen and Y4; pressure dips across the escalator descent and recovers on the way up.
Two escalator double-landings (BM12-BM13, BM23-BM24) have no walk recording between them; see missing_movements.csv.
